entities.name: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE
entities.description: ESM message sent by the UE to the network in response to an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: ESM information procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network requests ESM information from the UE and the UE responds with the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Access Point Name
entities.description: Identifies the packet data network that the UE wants to connect to.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Contains parameters for protocol configuration between UE and network.

relations.description: The ESM information procedure includes the UE sending the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.
The ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain the Access Point Name IE.
The ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain the Protocol configuration options IE.
